title: orcid-mock users file
description: Clients and users for orcid-mock, an ephemeral mock of the Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) service. Field names transliterate ORCID's own. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express (checksums, duplicates, one primary email) are enforced when the file loads.

name.description: Shown on the consent page; defaults to the client_id

member.description: A member client may read limited items; default false

orcid.description: Any block is accepted if the checksum is right; empty or absent mints an iD from the mint block

password.description: For the consent page's optional password prompt

deprecated_to.description: The primary record this one was merged into
